en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Of gaining knowledge about medicinal, aromatic and spice plants-morphology, origin, cultivation, contain substances and used in ornamental horticulture, medicine, food and culinary.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Botanical description, cultivation, substances of Ranunculaceae taxons (Aconitum, Nigella, Cimicifuga) and their use in pharmacy, food industry, cosmetics and ornamental horticulture. (allowance 2/2) a.Practical exercises: Description of the medicinal plants; trade in the world trade and in the Czech Republic, possibilities of use of assortment ZF MENDELU (pot plants etc.), use of printed and electronic information resources for presentations.2.Papaveraceae (Papaver); Paeoniaceae (Paeonia); Hypericaceae (Hypericum), Ericaceae (Calluna, Ledum, Arctostaphyllos, Vaccinium) (allowance 2/2) a.Characteristic of spicy plants, their importance for the world and the Czech Republic, changes in product range, applicability of assortment ZF MENDELU (pot plants, samples of tea).3.Primulaceae (Primula), Crassulaceae (Rhodiola), Saxifragaceae (Bergenia), Rosaceae (Alchemilla, Fragaria), Alliaceae (Allium), Iridaceae (Iris). (allowance 2/2) a.Laboratory - determination of the total content of phenolic substances, .ppt presentation4.Linaceae (Linum), Araliaceae (Hedera, Aralia); Apiaceae (Eryngium), Valerianaceae (Centranthus) (allowance 2/2) a.1st test; laboratory - determination of total flavonoid content and total antioxidant capacity, .ppt presentation5.Gentianaceae (Gentiana, Menyanthes); Boraginaceae (Pulmonaria) (allowance 2/2) a.Laboratory-determination of L-ascorbic acid, .ppt presentation6.Boraginaceae (Symphytum, Borago); Scrophulariaceae (Verbascum), Verbenaceae (Aloisia, Lippia, Phylla) (allowance 2/2) a.2nd test; laboratory - determination of the number of swelling, .ppt presentation7.Lamiaceae I (Ajuga, Teucrium, Dracocephallum, Phlomis, Prunella, Mentha, Salvia) (allowance 2/2) a.Characteristics of the group of aromatic plants, trade in the world and the Czech Republic, possibilities of using essential oil samples, laboratory: demonstration of essential oil distillation,. ppt presentation8.Lamiaceae II (Scutellaria, Lavandula, Origanum, Ocimum, Nepeta) (allowance 2/2) a..ppt presentation9.Asteraceae I (Echinops, Matricaria, Artemisia, Tanacetum, Santolina, Carthamus, Helichrysum) (allowance 2/2) a.3rd test; .ppt presentation10.Asteraceae II (Achillea, Bellis, Balsamita, Pyrethrum, Grindelia, Tussilago, Solidago) (allowance 2/2) a..ppt presentation
